title: Life and AD&D coverage

blocks.text: Voluntary life and AD&D are both paid by you, and you choose the amount within these limits.

items.label: Life for you
items.text: $10,000 up to $500,000 (no more than 5 times salary), in $10,000 steps.

items.label: No health questions
items.text: new hires can get up to $250,000 without a health application.

items.label: Spouse and children
items.text: optional. Spouse up to $250,000, children up to $10,000. You must elect coverage for yourself first.

items.label: AD&D
items.text: $10,000 to $500,000 for accidental death or dismemberment, on or off the job.

items.label: If you leave
items.text: you can keep the coverage through portability or convert it to an individual policy.

followUps: Are the eligibility hours the same?
